title: Bare 32-character value under an authentication header with no provider
summary: An X-Api-Key style header with a 32-character alphanumeric value sent to a reserved example host that names no provider.
rationale: The authentication carrier makes a credential reading credible, but the value matches two unprefixed 32-alphanumeric families and no provider evidence attributes it to either. Family recognition is unresolved. A generic header-credential policy is a separate question owned downstream and is not asserted here; entropy of the value is not evidence.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Missing: a provider host or name in the input, or a recorded project decision on unattributed header values. Family attribution and generic suspicion are kept separate.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
